reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E6) supports that electrospark deposition produces a compact, adherent HfNbTaTiZr coating on stainless steel and that HEA coatings can enhance corrosion resistance, but it provides no data on oxygen resistance at high temperature, no mechanical testing of the coated substrate, and no evidence that the coating acts as an oxygen diffusion barrier or that the substrate's mechanical properties are preserved.
premises: Electrospark deposition can produce a compact, adherent HfNbTaTiZr coating on a substrate
The coating acts as a barrier to oxygen diffusion, reducing oxidation
The coating improves corrosion resistance of the substrate
The coating process does not sacrifice the substrate's mechanical performance
The coating is effective at temperatures up to 1000 °C
